nodes.title: SG-3 · Build playable 80/20 game frontend
nodes.body:
Context: game/ holds a pure runtime (performAction, chooseOption, serializeState) and bedroom content, but no UI exists. Desired behavior: a Vite React TS app in game/frontend/ (placed under the existing game/ top-level folder) renders scene, hotspots, action menu, dialogue, choices, history and inventory in an 80/20 layout with a mobile drawer, persisting state to localStorage safely. Expected result: a player can play the opening scene. Why: first playable milestone.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the app loads, When there is no history, Then the intro copy 'Every great adventure begins with a question.' is shown
- Given a hotspot is clicked, When an action is chosen, Then game state updates and persists
- Given storage throws, When the app runs, Then play continues in memory
- Given a narrow viewport, When the drawer toggle is pressed, Then the story panel opens and collapses


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/ app and tests
- Out of scope: Contribution form and 'Suggest What Happens Next' flow
- Out of scope: Backend API calls
- Out of scope: Round countdown and admin UI
- Preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged
- Preserve: game/content/** YAML unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Vite + React + TypeScript under game/frontend/
- Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it


## Definition of done
- All four requirements completed with Act, Verify and Evidence


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Frontend scaffold with runtime state hook and safe localStorage persistence
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/state/persistence.ts has serializeState/deserializeState; createInitialState and performAction exist in game/. Desired behavior: game/frontend/ is a Vite React TS project whose useGame hook loads the bedroom world from game/content YAML, restores saved state, saves on every change inside try/catch, and falls back to in-memory play when storage fails. Expected result: state survives remount; storage errors never crash. Why: persistence requirement of SG-3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given saved state in localStorage, When the hook mounts, Then it returns that state
- Given no saved state, When the hook mounts, Then it returns createInitialState with activeDialogue 'intro'
- Given localStorage.setItem throws, When an action runs, Then state still updates and no error is thrown
- Given corrupt saved JSON, When the hook mounts, Then initial state is used


## Scope

nodes.description: Create the frontend module under game/frontend and the runtime hook layer that loads content, restores and saves state safely.
acceptance_criteria: Code compiles under tsc --noEmit strict
Behavior matches the requirement acceptance criteria

preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Files in code_paths implemented and type-check passes

steps.action: Create manifest named worldseed-frontend with scripts dev=vite, build=vite build, test=vitest run, typecheck=tsc --noEmit; dependencies react, react-dom, yaml; devDependencies vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event, @testing-library/jest-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom.

Create tsconfig with strict true, jsx react-jsx, module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, target ES2022, noEmit true, skipLibCheck true, types [vite/client, vitest/globals], include [src, tests, ../src].

Export defineConfig with plugins [react()], resolve.alias '@game' -> path to ../src (game/src), server.fs.allow ['..'], and test {environment:'jsdom', globals:true, setupFiles:['./tests/setup.ts'], include:['tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}']}.
steps.expected: vitest picks up jsdom and the alias

steps.action: Use import.meta.glob('../../../content/worlds/the-boys-room/**/*.yaml',{query:'?raw',import:'default',eager:true}) and yaml.parse to build a WorldDef and a SceneDef for 'bedroom'; export const world, export const scene (types from @game/state/types).

Export STORAGE_KEY='worldseed:game-state:v1'. readSaved(): GameState|null wraps window.localStorage.getItem and deserializeState (from @game/state/persistence) in try/catch, returning null on any throw or null value. writeSaved(state): boolean wraps setItem(serializeState(state)) in try/catch returning false on throw.
steps.expected: readSaved returns null on corrupt JSON; writeSaved returns false when setItem throws

steps.action: Export useGame(): initial state from readSaved() cast to GameState else createInitialState(world, scene); useState holds it; a useEffect calls writeSaved(state) on each change; return {state, scene, view: getSceneView(state, scene), act(objectId, actionId) using performAction, choose(index) using chooseOption}.
steps.expected: Hook returns state, view, act and choose; storage failure never throws
